generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.title: Beta Jump Around Target Behavior
generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.description: Allows an entity to jump around a target.

fields.title: Check Collision
fields.description: Enables collision checks when calculating the jump. Setting check_collision to true may affect performance and should be used with care.

fields.title: Entity Bounding Box Scale
fields.description: Scaling temporarily applied to the entity's AABB bounds when jumping. A smaller bounding box reduces the risk of collisions during the jump. When check_collision is true it also increases the chance of being able to jump when close to obstacles.
Conditions that need to be met for the behavior to start.

fields.title: Domain
fields.description: The domain the test should be performed in.

fields.title: Operator
fields.description: The comparison to apply with 'value'.

fields.title: Subject
fields.description: The subject of this filter test.

fields.title: Test
fields.description: The name of the test to apply.

fields.title: Value
fields.description: The value being compared with the test.

fields.title: Jump Angles
fields.description: The jump angles in float degrees that are allowed when performing the jump. The order in which the angles are chosen is randomized.

fields.title: Jump Cooldown Duration
fields.description: The time in seconds to spend in cooldown before this goal can be used again.

fields.title: Jump Cooldown When Hurt Duration
fields.description: The time in seconds to spend in cooldown after being hurt before this goal can be used again.

fields.title: Landing Distance From Target
fields.description: The range deciding how close to and how far away from the target the landing position can be when jumping.

fields.title: Landing Position Spread Degrees
fields.description: This angle (in degrees) is used for controlling the spread when picking a landing position behind the target. A zero spread angle means the landing position will be straight behind the target with no variance. A 90 degree spread angle means the landing position can be up to 45 degrees to the left and to the right of the position straight behind the target's view direction.

fields.title: Last Hurt Duration
fields.description: If the entity was hurt within these last seconds, the jump_cooldown_when_hurt_duration will be used instead of jump_cooldown_duration.

fields.title: Line Of Sight Obstruction Height Ignore
fields.description: If the entity's line of sight towards its target is obstructed by an obstacle with a height below this number, the obstacle will be ignored, and the goal will try to find a valid landing position.

fields.title: Max Jump Velocity
fields.description: Maximum velocity a jump can be performed at.

fields.title: Prepare Jump Duration
fields.description: The time in seconds to spend preparing for the jump.

fields.title: Required Vertical Space
fields.description: The number of blocks above the entity's head that has to be air for this goal to be usable.

fields.title: Snap To Surface Block Range
fields.description: The number of blocks above and below from the jump target position that will be checked to find a surface to land on.

fields.title: Valid Distance To Target
fields.description: Target needs to be within this range for the jump to happen.
